name: Aphelion of Venus
description:
[term:eclipse][blue]Eclipses[/blue][/term] Fire, Ice, and Plague Aspect. Applying those effects instead adds them to your [effect:atmosphere][dark-gray]atmosphere[/dark-gray][/effect] for 8 seconds.

[dark-gray]At a tragic juncture, noxious and suffocating.[/dark-gray]

effects.explanation: Enemies gain your atmosphere's effects only while within it. Its radius starts at 2 blocks and grows by 1 block every other attack.

discoveredBy: TroyTheCrafter, UnloadingLime, Schwump, and Shotdown01 on 05/28/25
